reports.title: Emerson Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Results;

guidance.heading: 2027 Outlook
section: The following tables summarize the fiscal year 2027 guidance framework, which assumes returning ~$3.8B through ~$2.5B of share repurchases and ~$1.3B of dividends.

Guidance figures are approximate. | 2027 Q1 | 2027
Net Sales Growth | ~5% | ~5%
Underlying Sales Growth | ~5% | ~5%
Earnings Per Share | $1.19 - $1.23 | ~$5.70
Amortization of intangibles | ~$0.35 | ~$1.41
Restructuring and related costs | ~$0.04 | ~$0.14
Adjusted Earnings Per Share | $1.58 - $1.62 | ~$7.25
Operating Cash Flow | $4.3B - $4.4B
Free Cash Flow | $3.8B - $3.9B
Share Repurchase | ~$1.5B | ~$2.5B
